name: Below
storyline:
Three months ago, Celestial Stones Research (CSR) abruptly shut down their massive excavation beneath the Great Pyramid. CSR officials openly acknowledge the discovery of colossal pillars beneath the great pyramids, but insist the site was closed strictly due to a lack of resources. Unofficial reports from local authorities tell a different story: something terrible happened down there.

One month after the site was sealed, ambitious freelance reporter Alex Levine went there to uncover the truth. He never returned.

Now, authorities have recovered his belongings. Among them is a single, heavily degraded VHS tape documenting his final hours.

The footage is extremely disturbing. You are strongly advised not to watch it.

But you will anyway.
summary: Survive heart-pounding chases in this first-person found footage psychological horror. With the help of a camcorder, explore dark tombs and tight halls under the great pyramid. Find its terrible secrets, manage your batteries and, if you can, SURVIVE.
